about.label: Our Story
about.lead: Born from a passion for spaces that move the soul.

items.text: We believe the most powerful designs are often those that know what to leave out. Restraint sharpens the focus on what truly matters — material, light, proportion, and the human experience within.
items.title: Restraint as a design tool

items.text: Every material carries history. We source with intention and specify with care, selecting surfaces that will age gracefully and develop patina over time — becoming richer with the lives lived within them.
items.title: Materials as memory

items.text: Natural light is our most important collaborator. We orient spaces to capture its quality at different moments of day, letting shadow and brightness choreograph the emotional character of each room.
items.title: Light as architecture

about.text1: Architecture Studio was founded in 2006 with a singular conviction: that the spaces we inhabit shape who we become. From our studios in New York, Oslo, and Milan, we've spent nearly two decades translating this belief into homes, towers, and interiors that endure.
about.text2: Our practice is built on deep collaboration — with clients, with craftspeople, with the contexts in which we work. We listen before we design, and we design before we draw.

contact.label: Let's Talk
contact.lead: Every great space begins with a conversation.

footer.tagline: Luxury architecture and interior design studio. Creating spaces that inspire since 2006.

philosophy.label: Our Philosophy
philosophy.text: We believe great design is invisible — it simply feels right. Our approach blends rigorous architectural thinking with an intuitive understanding of how people inhabit space. Every project is an opportunity to create something that transcends the ordinary.

steps.text: We begin by deeply understanding your vision, lifestyle, and the possibilities inherent in your space.
steps.title: Discovery

steps.text: Our team develops refined concepts that translate your aspirations into spatial narratives.
steps.title: Concept

steps.text: Every detail is considered — materials, light, proportion — to create a coherent whole.
steps.title: Design

steps.text: We oversee every aspect of delivery, ensuring the built result matches the design vision.
